gitCommit.subject: feat(legal): public legal, privacy-choice, security and support pages, in-app variants, and a release guard for drafts
gitCommit.body:
feat(legal): public legal, privacy-choice, security and support pages, in-app variants, and a release guard for drafts

The owner's brief of 2026-10-16 (docs/85). Every page is a DRAFT that
needs TSX-MR's approval, written from the code. No owner fact is invented:
each one is an input, and a production build refuses while any is blank.

- New pages, each in EN/FR/AR: /privacy-choices, /legal (legal notice) and
  /security, alongside /privacy, /terms, /support and /account-deletion.
  Each shows its version, its effective date, a "DRAFT — REQUIRES TSX-MR
  APPROVAL" notice and links to every other page. The footer lists them on
  public and signed-in pages alike. Pages print cleanly.
- /in-app/… variants of the seven pages for the mobile app: the same text,
  language links only, no sign-in, application, price or other site page.
  Never indexed (robots meta and X-Robots-Tag), and left out of the sitemap.
- Terms rewritten as v1.2 from the enforced rules: the 168 h website-only
  trial, access paid outside the app, 72 h grace and read-only, and an
  explicit statement that Dukan ERP is not a bank or mobile-money service.
  Promises the software does not keep were removed. Liability, indemnity,
  governing law and refunds are blockers.
- Privacy and deletion texts reconciled with the code inventory:
  - an email provider exists, off by default;
  - request logs carry the IP address, the user agent and IMEIs in URLs;
  - imported rows are kept, and nothing is purged on a schedule yet;
  - receipt photos keep their EXIF data, so "no GPS" is no longer claimed;
  - closure clears only some notes;
  - notifications keep names.
- Support gains access, trial, devices, imports, scanner, reports, security
  and status answers, plus support hours, languages and response time as
  required inputs.
- Release guard:
  - placeholder markers ([TO BE PROVIDED], TBD, TODO…) in any input or
    text are refused;
  - every page still marked draft is refused;
  - the security email is required.
  The preview and development builds are unaffected.

Tests: test/legal-pages.test.tsx (routes public and stable, one h1,
lang/dir, no fetch, version, draft label, related links, footer, operator
named, no contact or phone number in texts, no form on support, in-app pages
with no way out, noindex); site-config release-guard cases; parity and
source rules. vitest 376/376, typecheck clean, build:preview 66 pages, link
audit 0 broken out of 3255, bundle audit PASS.
